title: tmt registry v1
description: Normative schema for tmt.json, the committed repo-root tool registry. Each key under "tools" is a tool id and must equal the executable filename tools/<id>.

tools.description: One manifest entry per tool, keyed by tool id.

purpose.description: One-line discovery summary; hard-capped at 80 characters.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage; stable adds test, portability, and dependency gates.

lang.description: Implementation language: "python" (default), "sh", or a recorded exception.

json.description: True when the tool supports --json per cli-v1.

mutates.description: True when the tool changes state outside its own output.

idempotent.description: True when repeating the tool is safe.

requires.description: Sibling tool ids this tool executes; must resolve and stay acyclic.

config.description: Repo-relative paths of config files the tool reads; recorded for consumers, never copied by vendor/adopt.

origin.description: "local" for tools born here; a provenance stamp for vendored copies.

commit.description: Source commit at copy time; "unknown" when not resolvable.

url.description: Source repository's origin remote URL, recorded when one was configured at copy time.
